title: Replace Microsoft Access Database
problem_statement: The current system uses a Microsoft Access database which is outdated and not suitable for modern applications.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential data loss and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Migrate the database to a modern RDBMS like PostgreSQL or MySQL.
success_criteria: Database is successfully migrated to a new RDBMS.
All application components interact with the new database without errors.
